title: Replay judge not_frozen reads a config-constant wear price as a frozen mirror of the electricity price
claim: On the owner's replay window (hours 7-9) tests/replay.py:frozen_offenders reports compressor_starts.wear_price_per_start 'stayed 0.3 while sensor.price moved', although wear_price_per_start is replacement_cost / rated_starts (heatpump_optimizer.wear:wear_price_per_start), a constant that never moved in the window; hours 13-15 show the same with solar_heat_gain.orientation_factor 'stayed 0.7' against the price (a configured factor); restricting the judge to published series that moved at least once takes the count 1 -> 0.
mechanism: frozen_offenders takes a published series as a mirror of an input when at least MIRROR_MIN_HITS cycles and half the paired cycles lie within MIRROR_TOL of the input and two distinct non-zero input values matched. A published constant passes all three whenever the input hovers near it for a short window (an 8-cycle chunk, a price near 0.3), and then every later price move reads as the mirror freezing.
instrumented_symbol: tests/replay.py:frozen_offenders over heatpump_optimizer.coordinator's published wear_price_per_start (heatpump_optimizer.wear:wear_price_per_start) in the seeded replay

perturbation.change: --perturb constant: frozen_offenders judges only published series with at least two distinct values over the window, in memory

metric_definition: not_frozen offenders tests/replay.py:run_fixture returns over the seeded replay's hours 7-9 of the owner's window.
phenomenon_property: The not_frozen judge flags only a published value that tracked an input and then stopped: a series constant over the whole window is never a mirror.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub:tests:custom_components python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D15/s2/m5_judges.py --bundle B --from-hours F --hours H --offenders 8   # every not_frozen line whose published side never moved

null_control.note: hours 1-3, where the price does not hover near the constant

proposed_fix_scope: tests/replay.py:frozen_offenders: require the published series to have moved (two distinct values) before it can be a mirror, with a controls() arm of a constant beside an input that brushes it; no production change.
